purpose: Non-CIFAR real industrial inspection validation for lower-side late-recovery predictor.

definitions.pass_precision: precision among samples accepted as good
definitions.lost_final_reliable_rate: fraction of all samples that final-only would reliably pass as good but early rejector rejects
definitions.early_reject_rate: fraction of samples stopped before final execution
definitions.avg_cost: normalized mean compute cost; final-only is 1.0
